name: isStrongAuthRequired
definition: True when multi-factor authentication is enforced for every user in scope (a complete read of the population, no exemption left open).
population: the user accounts of one identity or access system in scope; denominator = every user account the read lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of every user account in scope showing a second factor is required at sign-in, with no account exempt.
citations: Validate that MFA is enforced for all users and what authTypesAllowed (integrationservice criteriakey-defaults.json)
safeguards/compliancemanagement/vanta/ and safeguards/compliancemanagement/drata/ isstrongauthrequired.py (third-party proof sources: the GRC platform's own test result, level 3 in the proof ladder)

changeLog.change: Registered so the GRC-platform proof-source transforms can emit it. The meaning is the existing catalogue description made precise; the roughly twenty existing implementations in other categories were not reviewed, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Registered for the Vanta and Drata proof-source transforms. Those answer from a GRC platform's own test results (third-party proof, level 3), never from a read of the tool, so allowedCategories is empty (cross-category evidence). Whether the other implementations of this key measure the same thing is not ruled; that review is open and the owner is not yet named.
